name: lfgos-sports-fiesta-2026
description: Official public read-only PWA and feed server for LFGOS Sports Fiesta 2026

scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('tools/build.mjs')) { require('child_process').execSync('node tools/build.mjs', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } else { console.log('tools/build.mjs not found, serving pre-built public directory'); }"
